messages:
tara (DevEx): heads-up: ruby/sample-sdk publish blocked after a regen this morning. changelog tool auto-incremented a minor even though the only change in generated code was an example ordering tweak.
lee (typegen): yep, we landed a change to stabilize examples by sorting query params lexically. intended non-breaking, but example hashes moved so changelog picked it up.
sam (sdk): this caused the semver guard in publish workflow to fail: `changelog vs tags` mismatch. UX: users see a minor bump for no functional change.
ci-bot: build 11458 failed: publish-sdk step `changelog-guard` -> mismatch detected. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/11458/logs
ops-bot: note: recent ruby sample uses pinned typegen SHA? looks like it was floating, so the regen happened during the automated publish.
tara (DevEx): immediate ask: what's the fastest unblock? we have a customer demo later.
lee (typegen): short term: add `--stable-examples` toggle and cut a patch release; long-term: update regen CI to run a dry-run changelog diff and surface semver noisy diffs to PR.
sam (sdk): temporary workaround: pin the typegen CLI used by the ruby sample's release job to the previous commit, then re-run publish. I'll open a PR to pin and include a note in the release checklist.
lee (typegen): i'll open a small PR to sort examples deterministically but with a clear comment stating it's example-only. also adding unit tests that assert example hashes don't change across stable inputs.
tara (DevEx): can we also relax the publish gate to allow maintainers to skip the semver guard with a documented override token while still requiring two approvers?
ops-bot: approved workflow change requires infra signoff. pinging infra channel.
lee (typegen): plan: 1) PR for `--stable-examples` + tests, 2) regen CI job that compares changelog before publish and annotates PR if mismatch, 3) notify SDK leads to pin or bump typegen accordingly.
sam (sdk): i'll do the ruby pin PR and increase flaky auth test timeout in sampleapp tests (ruby runner had intermittent 30->120s timeouts).
tara (DevEx): thanks — owners: lee (typegen PR + CI job), sam (ruby pin + test fix), tara (release checklist update + demo unblock). paste PR links here when ready. :rocket:
